New: With enhanced ACA premium subsidies expired and Medicaid cuts phasing in, the Congressional Budget Office expects the share of the population uninsured to rise above 10% for the first time since the ACA was implemented.

All the bad things that happen in the health care system in the coming years are likely to get blamed on cuts in the so-called One Big Beautiful Bill Act. In many cases, it'll be true. But, hospitals are also likely to use it as a reason for closures they planned anyway.
